Use case: precise-object-edit.
Complete the 14 correctly sized head stamps in image 1 into a dynamic attack_3 finishing lunge. Image 2 is the exact T1 healer, fixed face, robe and held whisk. Keep every head's size, profile, identity and guided path. All figures face RIGHT in E profile. Four columns, four rows; 14 frames row-major, last two cells empty magenta.

Frames 1–4: strong anticipation, sink into the hips and draw the right-hand whisk beside the waist. Preserve the deep lunge; do not flatten posture to keep a standing bounding box.

The right hand always grips one continuous plain brown shaft with ONE cylindrical bronze collar and soft white horsehair. Left palm opens forward for balance. The hair may bend and curl, but never becomes a sword, glow trail or second weapon. Keep the full whisk inside each cell.

Fixed adult female face, olive-brown almond eye, straight delicate brow, serene lips; flatter main hair cap, separate folded bun, jade pin, side strands. Same plain ivory T1 robe, jade collar/cuffs/sash, thin antique-gold edging, sparse ink hem, jade/ivory shoes. Hair, sash and sleeves lag the strike then settle. Two cel tones, small highlight, narrow rim, tinted outlines, NW light.

Preserve the head stamps' approximately 53.5 logical-pixel crown-to-chin scale; no head or whole-figure enlargement. Remove all grid, marks and crop edges. Solid #FF00FF. No floor, shadows, labels, aura, lotus, talismans, particles, blur, afterimages or extra figures.
